source_role: Existing Experiment 10 outputs reused only for calibration and subsequent development
control_selection: Within each agreed-D group, greedily prefer least-used setting-by-evidence cells; break ties by SHA-256. Representative of an exact triple is its lexically smallest sample_id. No matching or population-representativeness claim.
ordering: Independently SHA-256 ordered exact triples; opaque case IDs; source mapping withheld from the participant packet.
measurement: Set-valued direct/reported/both/none attribution, verbatim evidence, human rationale, preserved ambiguity
comparison_gate: Do not show source labels during annotation; compare only after all 52 cases are received and locked, or after an explicit partial-stop declaration. Never change original labels.
limits: Selected calibration sample of public data, one volunteer human, prior study exposure. Not blind adjudication, population accuracy, or fresh evaluation. Agreement does not establish shared-label correctness.
